messages:
Noah Rivera: Quick leadership note to start the week. Three things we need everyone to internalize: launch safeguards for EU Dedicated, tighten data retention policy, and a focused push on SLA reliability metrics.

Priya Shah: thanks noah. can you be specific on "tighten data retention"? what changes are we expecting?

Noah Rivera: Short version: default retention for hosted logs will go from 90d -> 30d for non-compliance customers. Audit logs and customer-specific retention remain configurable for enterprise + private. Legal + Security signed off.

Tara Singh: product impact: we'll add a banner in Console and an API flag so integrations can request longer retention. working with UX to avoid surprise.

Liam O'Neill: on EU Dedicated launch: target date remains two weeks, but we need a hard canary gate for model rollout and a KMS integration checklist for each pilot. deploy-bot, status on the canary?
deploy-bot: 2199999955 Canary started for eu-dedicated v1.0.0 on pool-3 (10% traffic). No errors observed in first 6h. Metrics: p50 45ms, p95 120ms.

Liam O'Neill: good. add KMS onboarding step: verify key rotation policy, cross-region replication disabled unless customer requests.

Priya Shah: security-bot, add retention change and KMS checklist to compliance tracker and notify customers with >10TB data.

security-bot: Added tasks: "Retention default change: 90->30d" and "EU Dedicated KMS checklist". Notifying CSMs for customers >10TB.

Noah Rivera: on reliability: weekly target is p95 <= 150ms hosted, error budget <= 0.5% for core routes. If any team's p95 drifts >20% in a week, raise an incident and exec triage within 24h.

Tara Singh: product will map top 10 customer routes to core routes and publish runbooks by Wed.

Liam O'Neill: infra ask: freeze non-critical kernel/driver upgrades in eu region until canary finishes. we'll allow security patches with review.

Noah Rivera: agreed. freeze stands for two weeks. exceptions by ENG-VP approval only.

Priya Shah: comms: legal + privacy will share a short customer FAQ template we can embed in outbound emails. will post draft by tomorrow.

Tara Singh: sales note: EU Dedicated pilots: 4 inbound leads, 1 signed LOI. CE needs the KMS checklist and SLA appendix to finalize.

Noah Rivera: approve sharing checklist with CE under NDA. emphasize SLA appendix.

Liam O'Neill: I'll run a pre-launch incident drill with oncall next Thu. will invite execs for 15m tabletop.

Priya Shah: small housekeeping: please ensure team OKRs include one reliability metric tied to p95 or error budget by EOD Fri. execs will review early next week.

Noah Rivera: thanks all 97 short, actionable list. Summary: retention default -> 30d, EU Dedicated canary + KMS checklist, freeze non-critical infra upgrades, p95 target <=150ms with incident escalation. I'll follow up with a 1-pager. :white_check_mark:
